arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, find race rhythm.

Fastest 8000 m: 6.4 out-and-back legs of 1250 m, about 45 min. Settle from the hard start to ~155-160 W pod (pre-race CP 154 W pod / 13.3 kJ; may be 10-25% off). TEST CP with heart rate in minutes 4-14: HR model says 151 bpm at CP, creep 4 bpm per 10 min, lag 30 s; at a steady effort a level HR = below CP, HR climbing faster than creep = above CP. Then set critical_power_pod_w belief. Hold even effort (slightly more into the current), spend reserve so it empties at the line: finish sprint from ~600-800 m to go. Watch for incidents: weed (GPS speed drops vs pod power on both directions) -> clear_rudder; pod drift (pod power vs HR mismatch) -> pod_gain belief; radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

arguments.text: Fastest 8000 m (out-and-back legs of 1250 m, ~45 min). Paddler own pacing ~165 W pod is too hot for pod CP 154; they say they have plenty (evidence, not fact). Control effort with back-to-back PIECES (they scale own effort ~165 W: -6% = 155 W, -9% = 150 W); keep ~152-157 W pod until ~1000 m to go, then finish sprint so the reserve empties at the line. CP test by heart rate: HR model 151 bpm at 154 W + creep 4 bpm/10 min; flat HR at steady effort = at/below CP; climbing >1 bpm/min = above. Set critical_power_pod_w belief once known. Incidents: weed (speed drop vs pod power in BOTH directions; measure() gps_minus at fixed share 0.678) -> clear_rudder; pod drift -> pod_gain belief; radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

Remaining course: rest of leg 5 north INTO headwind to turn at 6250 m, leg 6 south DOWNWIND 6250-7500 m, final 500 m north into headwind (last turn at 7500 m = 500 m to go). Effort: ~160 W pod to the 6250 m turn (own effort, fine); downwind leg 6 a piece about -6% (~150 W) to refill; call FINISH just after the last turn (~450-480 m to go).
